command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 -o root -g root /usr/local/libexec
cat > /tmp/inventory-api.new <<'ANTRIEB_API_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import socket
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server_version = "inventory-api"
    sys_version = ""

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path not in ("/", "/health", "/inventory"):
            self.send_error(404)
            return
        payload = {
            "service": "inventory-api",
            "status": "ok",
            "node": socket.gethostname(),
        }
        body = json.dumps(payload, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_API_EOF
install -m 0755 -o root -g root /tmp/inventory-api.new /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
cat > /tmp/inventory-api.service.new <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
